contract.format: UTF-8; exact literal header; quoted data with doubled quotes; CRLF records and unchanged embedded newlines; deterministic ascending local ID order; all duplicate entries exported. Import additionally accepts leading BOM and LF. Strict header/column count, quotes, boolean, nonblank title and nonnegative ordered integer timestamps; malformed UTF-8 rejected.
contract.normalization: Empty optional username/url/notes/category cells normalize to null. This format cannot distinguish optional null/empty. Required password cell may be empty and is never trimmed; all nonempty field values remain exact.

limits.memory: Aggregate character and record budgets bound parsed text/object allocation, separate SQL payload preflight bounds full-entry reads; not a total JVM heap or erasure guarantee.

contract.duplicates: Exact case-sensitive title + username, null/empty username equivalent, against existing and earlier rows. Skip default is repeat-idempotent. Update selects lowest local ID and leaves other existing matches, preserving ID/createdAt; same-file rows apply in order to that target. Keep both always creates new local IDs.
contract.timestamps: New rows retain imported created/updated. Update uses max(stored+1, imported updated, repository clock). Stored Long.MAX_VALUE rejects the transaction; ordinary edit raises safe save failure rather than SQLite REAL coercion or false missing-entry status.
contract.transaction: Complete bounded parse before mutation; ephemeral whole-existing-state digest and counts rechecked within Room transaction. Concurrent changes refresh confirmation/reset policy. All accepted rows commit together. Injected SQL failure and pre-commit cancellation roll back; already committed imports are not undone by later UI cancellation.
contract.formulas: Values are preserved, never prefixed. Warning explicitly says spreadsheets may interpret formulas and formatting; quoting is not formula protection.
contract.provider: CREATE_DOCUMENT text/csv with harmless filename and OPEN_DOCUMENT with CSV/text/octet-stream handling. Content URIs only; no filesystem inference or persisted grant. Selected provider may be remote. Close/flush errors cannot report success; cancelled/failed export warns about partial plaintext and requests supported deletion only for that created document. No import-source deletion, plaintext temporary file, atomic-provider-write or secure-erasure promise.
contract.lifecycle: Activity Result registration outside unlocked subtree; Activity VM holds nonsecret pending action/URI only, without process persistence. Every returned selection requires current unlock and renewed explicit confirmation. Access-owned VM holds rows/preview only in memory, survives rotation, clears on revoke. Work is cancelled/joined, stream-close cancellation watcher runs on IO; uncooperative provider open/close may still delay return. Stale callbacks never auto-start I/O. All new dialogs call ProtectDialogWindow.
